outreach_text:
Hello The Park Bakery team,

I'm Amala from MultiMax. We build affordable websites for local businesses. I came across your bakery on St John's Lane in Bristol and prepared an independent website concept presenting your bread, cakes, savouries and contact details.

Your public listings pointed me to Facebook, and I did not find a standalone official website during my checks. This is an unsolicited concept, not your official website or an endorsement. The bread artwork is an illustration, not a photograph of your products.

Live preview:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/websites/the-park-bakery-bristol/

Source code:
https://github.com/amalraj020-a11y/10am-office-work/tree/main/websites/the-park-bakery-bristol

I've attached two current screenshots showing the desktop and mobile versions. They are also available here:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/the-park-bakery-bristol-desktop.png
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/the-park-bakery-bristol-mobile.png

If this direction appeals to you, please reply and we can discuss the changes you would like and a small agreed budget before any paid work begins. The preview does not take orders or payments. Backend or database features would be optional later work, agreed separately.

If this isn't of interest, let me know and I won't follow up.

Kind regards,
Amala
MultiMax
